message: User svc-reporting has an access key that has not been used in more than 45 days.
status_detail: User svc-reporting has an access key that has not been used in more than 45 days.

finding_info.title: IAM user does not have unused access keys older than 45 days
finding_info.desc: **IAM users** are evaluated for **active access keys** whose `last-used` timestamp exceeds `max_unused_access_keys_days` (default `45`). Users without access keys, or whose keys were used within this window, are reported separately.

remediation.desc: Disable or delete **unused access keys** promptly and prefer **IAM roles** with temporary credentials. Enforce **least privilege**, rotation, and time-bounded access. Monitor `last-used` metadata and automate deactivation of idle keys. Use federation/SSO to avoid long-lived user keys.

message: Instance bgp-batch-worker-1 does not require IMDSv2.
status_detail: Instance bgp-batch-worker-1 does not require IMDSv2.

finding_info.title: EC2 instance requires IMDSv2 or has the instance metadata service disabled
finding_info.desc: **EC2 instances** are evaluated for **IMDSv2 enforcement**: metadata endpoint enabled with `http_tokens: required`, or metadata service fully disabled (`http_endpoint: disabled`).

remediation.desc:
Apply defense in depth:
- Require **IMDSv2** tokens on all instances (`http_tokens: required`)
- Disable metadata where not needed (`http_endpoint: disabled`)
- Minimize hop limit to `1` when feasible
- Update SDKs/apps for IMDSv2
- Restrict instance profile permissions (least privilege)
- Block metadata access from untrusted workloads

message: Security group bgp-legacy-bastion allows SSH (TCP 22) from 0.0.0.0/0.
status_detail: Security group bgp-legacy-bastion allows SSH (TCP 22) from 0.0.0.0/0.

finding_info.title: Security group does not allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 to TCP port 22 (SSH)
finding_info.desc:
**EC2 security groups** are assessed for **inbound SSH exposure** by locating ingress rules that allow `TCP 22` from the Internet (`0.0.0.0/0` or `::/0`).

Only groups in use are considered; sets already flagged for all-port exposure are not repeated.

remediation.desc:
Apply **least privilege** to SSH:
- Disallow `0.0.0.0/0` and `::/0`; allow only trusted IPs or VPN ranges
- Prefer **private access** via bastion hosts or AWS Systems Manager Session Manager
- Enforce **key-based auth**, disable passwords, rotate keys
- Add **network segmentation** and monitoring for **defense in depth**

message: KMS key bgp-attachments-key does not have automatic rotation enabled.
status_detail: KMS key bgp-attachments-key does not have automatic rotation enabled.

finding_info.title: KMS customer-managed symmetric CMK has automatic rotation enabled
finding_info.desc: **Customer-managed KMS symmetric keys** in the `Enabled` state are evaluated to confirm `automatic rotation` of key material is configured

remediation.desc: Enable **automatic rotation** on customer-managed symmetric KMS keys and choose a rotation period that meets policy. Enforce **least privilege** and **separation of duties** for key administration versus usage. Monitor key lifecycle events and use on-demand rotation when compromise is suspected.

message: VPC bgp-prod-vpc does not have flow logs enabled.
status_detail: VPC bgp-prod-vpc does not have flow logs enabled.

finding_info.title: VPC flow logs are enabled
finding_info.desc:
**AWS VPCs** have **Flow Logs** configured to capture IP traffic for their network interfaces and deliver records to a logging destination.

VPCs lacking an active flow log configuration are highlighted.

remediation.desc:
Enable **VPC Flow Logs** for all VPCs to provide baseline telemetry.
Prefer capturing at least `REJECT` and, for sensitive networks, `ALL`. Send logs to a centralized, access-controlled destination with retention. Apply **least privilege** to writers/readers and integrate with monitoring for **defense in depth**.

message: Trail bgp-app-trail does not have log file validation enabled.
status_detail: Trail bgp-app-trail does not have log file validation enabled.

finding_info.title: CloudTrail trail has log file validation enabled
finding_info.desc:
**AWS CloudTrail trails** are evaluated for **log file integrity validation** being enabled (`LogFileValidationEnabled`).

When enabled, CloudTrail generates signed digest files to verify that S3-delivered log files remain unchanged.

remediation.desc:
Enable **log file integrity validation** on all trails (`LogFileValidationEnabled=true`).

Enforce **least privilege** on the logs bucket, retain and protect digest files (e.g., S3 Object Lock/MFA Delete), and monitor validation results to support **defense in depth**.

message: <root_account> passed: Root account has MFA enabled.
status_detail: <root_account> passed: Root account has MFA enabled.

finding_info.title: Root account has MFA enabled
finding_info.desc:
**AWS root user** with active credentials is assessed for **MFA activation**. The evaluation considers whether the root identity has a password or access keys and whether **MFA is enabled**.

*If centralized root access is enabled in Organizations, the presence of individual root credentials is also noted.*

remediation.desc: Enable **MFA** for the root user, preferably **hardware-based** or a dedicated, managed device. Remove root access keys and avoid using root for daily tasks. Apply **least privilege** with IAM Identity Center for admins, and use Organizations to **centralize root access** and eliminate long-lived root credentials.

message: mlee passed: IAM user has MFA enabled for console access or no console password is set.
status_detail: mlee passed: IAM user has MFA enabled for console access or no console password is set.

finding_info.title: IAM user has MFA enabled for console access or no console password is set
finding_info.desc: **IAM users** that have a console password are expected to have **multi-factor authentication** enabled. The evaluation identifies users who can sign in to the AWS Management Console but do not have an active MFA device associated.

remediation.desc: Enforce **MFA** for all console-capable IAM users; prefer **phishing-resistant** authenticators (FIDO2/security keys) and register backups. Remove console passwords for users that don't need them and favor **federation/SSO**. Apply least privilege and require MFA for sensitive actions to prevent unauthorized changes.

message: password-policy passed: IAM password policy requires passwords to be at least 14 characters long.
status_detail: password-policy passed: IAM password policy requires passwords to be at least 14 characters long.

finding_info.title: IAM password policy requires passwords to be at least 14 characters long
finding_info.desc: **IAM password policy** is assessed for the **minimum password length** setting, confirming it meets `>= 14` characters for IAM console users.

remediation.desc:
Set the **minimum password length** to `>= 14` (prefer `16+`).
- Require mixed character types and prevent reuse
- Enforce **MFA** for all console users
- Prefer SSO over local IAM users
- Apply least privilege and monitor authentication events

message: org-trail passed: Region has at least one CloudTrail trail logging.
status_detail: org-trail passed: Region has at least one CloudTrail trail logging.

finding_info.title: Region has at least one CloudTrail trail logging
finding_info.desc: **AWS CloudTrail** has at least one trail with `logging` enabled in every region. A **multi-region trail** or a regional trail counts for coverage in that region.

remediation.desc:
Use a **multi-region CloudTrail trail** or per-region trails so `logging` is active in every region, including unused ones.

Centralize logs, enforce **least privilege** to log stores, and add **defense-in-depth** with encryption, integrity validation, and retention. Continuously monitor trail health to catch gaps.

message: org-trail passed: CloudTrail trail logs are encrypted at rest with a KMS key.
status_detail: org-trail passed: CloudTrail trail logs are encrypted at rest with a KMS key.

finding_info.title: CloudTrail trail logs are encrypted at rest with a KMS key
finding_info.desc: **AWS CloudTrail trails** are evaluated for use of **SSE-KMS** with a customer-managed KMS key to encrypt delivered log files at rest in S3. Trails without a configured KMS key are identified. *Applies to single-Region and multi-Region trails.*

remediation.desc: Enable **SSE-KMS** on every trail using a **customer-managed KMS key**. Apply **least privilege** so only authorized roles can `Decrypt`, and enforce **separation of duties** between key admins and log readers. Rotate keys and monitor key usage to provide **defense in depth** for CloudTrail data.

message: bgp-prod passed: RDS DB instance storage is encrypted at rest.
status_detail: bgp-prod passed: RDS DB instance storage is encrypted at rest.

finding_info.title: RDS DB instance storage is encrypted at rest
finding_info.desc: **RDS DB instances** are assessed for **KMS-based encryption at rest** (`StorageEncrypted=true`), covering instance storage and derived artifacts such as snapshots, automated backups, and read replicas.

remediation.desc: Enable **encryption at rest** for all RDS instances. Prefer **customer-managed KMS keys** to control rotation and fine-grained access, applying **least privilege** and **defense in depth**. Restrict key usage, monitor key activity, and manage key lifecycle. Migrate unencrypted instances via encrypted snapshot copy and restore.

message: bgp-prod passed: RDS instance has backup retention period greater than 0 days.
status_detail: bgp-prod passed: RDS instance has backup retention period greater than 0 days.

finding_info.title: RDS instance has backup retention period greater than 0 days
finding_info.desc: **RDS DB instances** are evaluated for **automated backups** by confirming the backup retention period is greater than `0` days, indicating point-in-time recovery is configured.

remediation.desc:
Enable **automated backups** with retention > `0` aligned to RPO/RTO. Regularly test restores to validate **PITR**.

Apply **least privilege** to backup access, encrypt snapshots, and replicate critical backups to separate locations for **defense in depth** and resilient recovery.

message: ebs-default-encryption passed: EBS default encryption is enabled.
status_detail: ebs-default-encryption passed: EBS default encryption is enabled.

finding_info.title: EBS default encryption is enabled
finding_info.desc: **EBS** uses `encryption by default` at the account and region level, ensuring new volumes, snapshots, and AMI-backed volumes are automatically encrypted with a chosen **KMS key**

remediation.desc: Enable `EBS encryption by default` in every region and select a **customer-managed KMS key**. Apply **least privilege** to key use, rotate keys, and monitor access. Enforce encrypted volume creation with organizational guardrails and secure templates as **defense in depth**.

message: 2cb1a3d4e5f6 passed: GuardDuty detector is enabled and not suspended.
status_detail: 2cb1a3d4e5f6 passed: GuardDuty detector is enabled and not suspended.

finding_info.title: GuardDuty detector is enabled and not suspended
finding_info.desc: **Amazon GuardDuty** detector existence and health are evaluated per Region. It identifies where GuardDuty isn't enabled for the account, where a detector has no status, or where a detector is configured but `suspended`.

remediation.desc: Enable and keep **GuardDuty** active in all supported Regions and accounts under a delegated admin. Turn on relevant protection plans and auto-enroll new accounts. Avoid `suspended` detectors, enforce **least privilege** for admins, and integrate findings into response for **defense in depth**.

message: bgp-attachments passed: S3 bucket is not publicly accessible to Everyone or Authenticated Users.
status_detail: bgp-attachments passed: S3 bucket is not publicly accessible to Everyone or Authenticated Users.

finding_info.title: S3 bucket is not publicly accessible to Everyone or Authenticated Users
finding_info.desc: **Amazon S3 buckets** are evaluated for **public access** via ACLs and bucket policies. The check identifies account or bucket `PublicAccessBlock` protections (`IgnorePublicAcls`, `RestrictPublicBuckets`) and flags buckets granting group access to `AllUsers` or `AuthenticatedUsers`, or with a public bucket policy.

remediation.desc: Enforce defense in depth: enable **S3 Block Public Access** at org/account and bucket levels (`BlockPublicAcls`, `IgnorePublicAcls`, `BlockPublicPolicy`, `RestrictPublicBuckets`). Apply **least privilege** with explicit principals; avoid ACLs via Object Ownership. Use private access patterns (e.g., CloudFront OAC or presigned URLs) and monitor with analyzers.

message: default passed: Security Hub is enabled with standards or integrations configured.
status_detail: default passed: Security Hub is enabled with standards or integrations configured.

finding_info.title: Security Hub is enabled with standards or integrations configured
finding_info.desc: **AWS Security Hub** is `ACTIVE` in the Region and has at least one enabled **security standard** or connected **integration**. Otherwise, it is either not enabled or enabled without standards/integrations.

remediation.desc:
- Enable in all required accounts/Regions
- Turn on relevant **standards** (`AWS FSBP`, `CIS`)
- Connect AWS and third-party **integrations**
- Use **central configuration** and **least privilege**
- Automate triage and monitor continuously for **defense in depth**
